item.title: DevSecOps Engineering Manager
item.description:
We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our DevOps, CloudOps and SecOps technology groups. You’ll be responsible for growing high-performing engineering teams, optimizing resource allocation and chargeability, managing the department budget and partnering with Business teams to deliver technical solutions for new opportunities.

This is a hands-on leadership role that combines people management, operational excellence and business enablement.
